CiukiOS P5 multimedia libraries are free software under LGPL version 2.1
or (at your option) any later version. See COPYING.LIB and upstream LICENSE.
There is no warranty, including merchantability or fitness for a purpose.

Complete corresponding source for the shipped P5 libraries is supplied in
this CiukiOS source distribution: sdk/win32/codecs/, scripts/win32/codecs.py,
third_party/wine/codecs/, and the build integration in scripts/win32/.
Rebuild with clang/lld and Python using scripts/win32/build-wine-dlls.sh
--codecs. There are no secret source patches or binary-only codec payloads.
You may modify, rebuild and replace these DLLs, subject to the LGPL.

The original CiukiOS DirectSetup identity DLLs (dsetup.dll and dsetup32.dll)
are also LGPL-2.1-or-later. Their complete corresponding source is supplied
in sdk/win32/upper/dsetup.c with scripts/win32/upper_dlls.py and the shell
entry point scripts/win32/build-wine-dlls.sh --installer-builtins.
They contain no Wine implementation. There is no claim that a URL-only
source offer would suffice for distributing a Wine binary.

The referenced Wine sources are Wine 10.0, commit
b073859675060c9211fcbccfd90e4e87520dc2c2, available at:
https://github.com/wine-mirror/wine/tree/b073859675060c9211fcbccfd90e4e87520dc2c2
https://dl.winehq.org/wine/source/10.0/wine-10.0.tar.xz
These links supplement the supplied corresponding source; they do not
replace an obligation to supply corresponding source with distribution.

The CiukiOS image (build/f0/ciukios.img, built by make build-full)
distributes sixteen reused P4 PEs built from Wine 10.0: advpack.dll,
cabinet.dll, combase.dll, comctl32.dll, comdlg32.dll, coml2.dll, msvcrt.dll,
ole32.dll, oleaut32.dll, riched20.dll, riched32.dll, rpcrt4.dll, setupapi.dll,
shcore.dll, shell32.dll and shlwapi.dll under /System/Win32. Their complete
corresponding source consists of the exact Wine 10.0 archive (SHA-256 in
config/wine-pin.json), third_party/wine/patches/ (applied in the order of
PATCHES.md; 0006 is the recorded SHELL32 icon filter, applied by
scripts/win32/wine_upper.py), the complete scripts/win32/ recipe and helper
sources (including wine_upper.py, upper_dlls.py, census.py and wine_audit.py),
that pin and the build record
config/wine-upper.json (which holds the SHA-256 of every PE). Archive
verification and the patch order are enforced by the recipe; "make upper"
rebuilds the PEs from this source set and the build refuses any PE whose
SHA-256 differs from the record. Any distribution of the image, or of a bundle
that contains one of these PEs, must make this source set available from the
same distribution location, with these notices (LGPL-2.1, sections 4 and 6); the
local ignored archive and the upstream links alone are not a published source
distribution. The bundled musl and zlib notices are retained separately as
musl-COPYRIGHT.txt and zlib-NOTICE.txt, including in the image's WINE-*
notices; their original source-file notices remain in the exact archive.

The fx-hlutils recipe additionally builds oledlg.dll and wininet.dll from
that exact archive, with patch 0016-wininet-no-tls.patch (MSVCRT selection
and the documented failure for unavailable TLS). They are LGPL-2.1-or-later.
Their qualification status is recorded in config/wine-upper.json; a build
alone does not authorize distribution as a qualified system DLL. The exact
patch, archive, recipe and notices are part of their corresponding source.
